scope: Owner-approved architecture, fixture reliability, obsolete test/client removal and duplicated abstraction consolidation

recommendations.change: Disposable uninstalled CLI state and isolated Git config, identity, signing and templates across engine subprocesses.

Shared retained child exit, idempotent bounded stop, readiness/operation observation and engine/background drain before journal removal; fixed sleeps and unbounded cleanup waits removed from affected fixtures.
Removed unused S0 CLI and Swift DevelopmentClient, its obsolete parity test and an exact read-call count assertion; current schema and real native IPC coverage preserved.
Resource/storage/power command handlers own fields, maintenance predicates, execution and retained failures; Engine retains common gates and scheduling.
Shared reviewed-policy transaction mechanics preserve historical digest inputs, namespaces, extra resource collision guard and replay ordering.
Small and large immutable reads share owned-descriptor identity verification, with distinct byte caps, buffering and exit semantics preserved.
All seven secret-scanner boundary tests are included in check with an explicit Gitleaks prerequisite.

investigation.resolution: Reduce default test-file concurrency from four to two without bypassing ownership checks; focused restart cleanup repairs drain every owner.
investigation.observedFailure: Detailed failures reported Git actualExitCode 0 with PROCESS_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED cleanup; ownership checks conservatively refused completion.
investigation.tradeoff: Reduced test-file concurrency preserves every case and ownership check. The final complete Node run took 920668 ms (about 15.3 minutes).
